My recommendation: If you already have a microphone arm, Walmart at $69.34 looks like the better deal, provided you're comfortable with the third-party seller and its return policy. Otherwise, the Best Buy PD200XS kit at $79.99 is worth considering.

One important detail: the standalone PD200X doesn't include a desk stand, so factor in the cost of a boom arm if you don't own one.
